text: Tools & Skills Manager 是一款面向 DSH Web 客户端的工具与技能管理插件。它在设置页提供配置档和项目两种作用范围，让你查看工具、技能目录并调整启用策略；项目可以继承配置档默认值，也可单独强制启用或关闭。你还可以搜索条目、批量更改筛选结果，并为项目技能选择仅保留某项。插件随工作目录变化更新会话策略，并将设置写回当前配置档。

Tools & Skills Manager is a DSH plugin for controlling tools and skills by project. Its Settings page lists catalogs, supports search and bulk changes, and lets projects inherit profile defaults or force entries on or off. It updates policy when the working directory changes and saves to profile.
我想让不同项目分别启用或关闭 DSH 工具。
能不能在设置页面管理项目里的技能开关？
I need tool and skill settings to follow each session's project directory.
Tools & Skills Manager 的功能「项目级开关」：在设置页选择项目后，可为工具或技能设定继承、强制启用或强制关闭；切换会话工作目录时，插件会重新应用对应策略。
Tools & Skills Manager 的功能「目录批量管理」：设置页列出工具或技能并支持搜索；可对当前筛选出的条目批量启用、关闭，也可清除项目覆写。

text:
@local/tool-skill-manager README · Install：```yaml
- id: tool-skill-manager
  name: '@local/tool-skill-manager'
  config:
    disabledTools: []      # profile default

The `id` must stay unique and addressable: the Settings page persists through `configEditor`, which refuses to write an entry it cannot address unambiguously.

@local/tool-skill-manager README · Configuration：| Field | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `disabledTools` | Global tool names disabled for every project (the profile default) |
| `disabledSkills` | Global skill names disabled for every project |
| `projects.<absolute root>.tools.<name>` | `true` force-enables, `false` force-disables; omit to inherit |
| `projects.<absolute root>.skills.<name>` | Same override semantics for skills |

@local/tool-skill-manager README · Configuration：A project boundary is the nearest ancestor of the session's working directory that contains a `.git` marker — the same rule `dsh-skill-filesystem` uses for project skill roots, falling back to the working directory itself.

```yaml
- id: tool-skill-manager
  name: '@local/tool-skill-manager'
  config:
    disabledTools: [weather]

Overrides are machine-local: they live in the active profile's patch, not in the project repository.

@local/tool-skill-manager README · Settings page：- **Scope selector** — `Profile defaults` or any live/configured project. `Add project…` registers an absolute path; `Remove project` deletes its overrides.
- **Tools / Skills tabs** — search, per-row switches, bulk enable/disable, and (project scope) a tri-state override: inherit, force on, force off.
- **Skills** additionally shows source invocation policy and a project-scope “Keep only this” action.
- Sessions are re-evaluated on every `working-directory/change`: moving a session into another checkout immediately switches its tool restriction and skill overlay.

@local/tool-skill-manager README · Enforcement：- **Tools** — the effective project policy becomes a per-agent `tools.restrict({ deny })`; names are denied as soon as their plugin registers them, so a disabled tool never reaches the model.
- **Skills** — a per-agent provider overlays disabled entries as uninvocable (stable catalog), and a `skill`-tool guard refuses to load them.

@local/tool-skill-manager README · Development：```bash
npm test      # node --test test/*.test.js
```

The tests use a fake Cordis context: per-agent tool restrictions, skill overlay/guard, working-directory changes, project overrides, project registration/removal, and route validation.
